subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Tell 12-hour time in hours and half hours on an analogue clock

show.line: A clock has two hands. The short hand shows the hour. The long hand points up at twelve. Three o'clock!

rounds.praise: Yes! The short hand points to seven.

rounds.prompt: Look at the clock. What time is it? Say the time.
Which hand is the hour hand?
rounds.praise: Yes! The short hand tells the hour.
Yes! Both hands point to twelve.

rounds.prompt: School starts at this time. What time is it?
One o'clock, two o'clock, three o'clock. What time comes next?
rounds.praise: Four o'clock! The hours go round in order.

hints: Find the short hand. Which number does it point to?
The long hand points straight up at twelve for o'clock.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will read this clock.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: The short hand points to four. It is twelve o'clock!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I read the long hand. The short hand says four o'clock.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. Short hand on four, long hand on twelve. Four o'clock!

parent_line: Can read o'clock times on a clock with hands.
